WAS great but now… worthless. Three times I’ve entered my workout for the day, but it keeps getting deleted and since the app won’t let you move to the next workout it keeps giving me the SAME workout that I’ve already done!

Too bad, it was great before they “updated” it to improve it. As the old saying goes, “If it ain’t broke don’t fix it!”

reviews.text:
Transformative Fitness Companion!. The “HabitNest Weightlifting Transformation Journal” has been my go-to companion on this fitness journey, and it has truly transformed the way I approach my workouts and overall well-being.

The structured format of the journal makes it easy to document each weightlifting session, helping me track progress, set goals, and celebrate achievements. The visual representation of my journey through charts and graphs adds an extra layer of motivation.

What sets this app apart is its emphasis on habit formation. The habit-tracking features have been instrumental in keeping me accountable, ensuring that I stay consistent with my workouts even during challenging times. The reminders and prompts have become a friendly nudge in the right direction.

The inclusion of insightful prompts for reflection allows me to not only focus on the physical aspect of my transformation but also delve into the mental and emotional aspects. This holistic approach aligns perfectly with my desire for a well-rounded fitness journey.

As someone navigating health concerns and anxiety, the HabitNest app fosters a positive and empowering atmosphere. It’s not just about lifting weights, it’s about building a sustainable and fulfilling lifestyle.

In summary, if you’re serious about your weightlifting journey and want a tool that goes beyond just logging workouts, the HabitNest Weightlifting Transformation Journal is a game-changer. It’s the perfect blend of structure, motivation, and mindfulness.

reviews.text:
Arbitrary workout timers ruin app functionality. This app asks you to commit to a habit each day. In my case I wanted to use it for working out. I missed a step of completing my first workout. The next day I couldn’t open the second workout and realized I needed to complete the last step of the first one. Then I couldn’t workout because a 23 hour timer popped up locking me out of the second workout. I can’t even prepare for the workout by looking at the exercises, I’m completely locked out. You also can’t skip workouts. It’s not good when a book is actually better than the app. This system seems arbitrary and capricious.

Lastly, I travel a lot and don’t have access to the same equipment all the time. The workouts seem to follow the same muscle groups. It would be best if I could them them, but I’m locked out of this too for an arbitrary reason.

Long Time Fan. I have been using Habit Nest Journals for years. As someone who has bipolar, I often “fall off the wagon” of life. Downward spirals have me abandoning habits I’ve built again and again. I always turn to Habit Nest to pick myself up again. 

Their journals have helped me recover and reclaim my life faster than I did before. They’ve helped me develop habits I didn’t have even before the fall. They’ve helped me develop habits that keep me from falling completely. 

The app is well worth the wait. It has everything wonderful about the journals and more. You can tell they have put everything into it to help anyone who needs a little motivation and support. 

Highly recommend this app to everyone who is looking to take a little time from each day and change it into something life changing.

Life-Changing!. Two years ago I was gifted a Habit Nest “Morning Sidekick” journal. It literally changed my life. I began to look forward to waking up so that I could do my morning routine and get a good start on the day. 

With this app I can see that they took what worked with the journals and innovated and amplified the experience. I’m so extremely impressed with the app! I bought a year-long subscription and I love that I can work on more than one habit at a time. I’m currently doing the morning and evening routines. I’m very excited to do the meditation and limiting screen time habits next. I appreciate the variety of meaningful content, care and attention to detail that the team put into this app. 

Thank you so much, Habit Nest! I’m a life-long customer and so proud of the work I’ve accomplished with your support. This is the ultimate self-help program. I’d recommend it to everyone who wants to get the most out of their days, reduce stress and live a more present and meaningful life.
